reason: My deals already come through my manager, my WhatsApp group and Insta DMs, and I can smell a fake 'pay registration fee' offer myself by now. Another app to sign into for café and salon invites that probably pay less than my rate isn't worth my time.
objection: Local café and gym invites are usually small fees, and if I take too many of them my followers will think I'm promoting every shop in the city. I don't need more small deals, I need fewer, better ones.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked fully inside WhatsApp, where I just forward a DM and get the check back, and if the businesses on it showed fees at or above my usual rate, I'd try it.
